verdict.rationale: Ledgy's evidence shows some international orientation: equity expense reporting under IFRS 2 and UK GAAP, and global mobility reporting for equity and tax as employees move across borders. Nothing in the pack covers HMRC/EMI valuations or country-specific option plan schemes, so support for the story's core is only implied. Missing for 10: HMRC/EMI valuation support, EMI or other country-specific option scheme administration, non-US valuation workflows, independent corroboration.
